summary: Reproduces on ground truth and on all 20 stable releases back to v1.4.1907 (zero invalid probes). Passing a struct by value from a StructuredBuffer loads the whole element, where indexing the buffer directly loads only the fields used; both spellings exit 0 and emit valid DXIL, so this is a codegen-quality gap, not a correctness defect. Measured comparatively -- both entry points on all 21 builds -- because a one-sided bisect cannot tell 'test1 regressed' from 'test2 improved'. Nothing has moved since the report and no issue text is stale.
title: struct value on "stack"
